# [sync] PWA: Vault-unreachable badge removed from the Settings nav; Vault row shows last success and last error; new alert-delay field (datawatch v9.131.0)

**Not filed yet.** This is the corrected draft for Automaton `48540001`. It replaces the three auto-generated drafts dated 2026-11-10 (`*-pwa-vault-nav-badge-removed-parity.md`, `*-vault-nav-label-clear-and-howto-parity.md`, `*-vault-unreachable-alert-threshold-parity.md`); file this one issue instead. Nothing has been created on any tracker.

## Affected area

datawatch-app (Android and iOS): the Settings entry, the Vault status row and the secrets settings. The daemon change shipped in v9.131.0.

## Current behavior after this work

Daemon side (nothing for the app to implement except reading it):
- The daemon watches the active Vault backend (only when `secrets.backend` is `vault`), checking every 15 seconds. When the Vault has been unreachable continuously for `secrets.vault.unreachable_alert_after_seconds`, it raises one system error alert titled "Vault unreachable" (Vault address and last error only, token-like text scrubbed), once per outage. When the Vault answers again it raises one info alert "Vault recovered". System alerts without a session reach the Alerts list and the messaging channels, so the app sees them through the normal alert feed.
- `secrets.vault.unreachable_alert_after_seconds`: whole seconds, default 120, `0` = alert off, negative refused. Set by config file, `PUT /api/config` (400 on a negative, fractional or non-numeric value), `GET /api/config` (returns the effective value under `secrets.vault`), `config_set` (MCP), `datawatch config set`, and chat `configure`. No new MCP tool and no new REST route.

PWA side:
- The red `!` Vault-unreachable badge on the Settings nav button is gone.
- The Vault status row shows two new lines, **Last success** (or "never") and **Last error** (or "none"). Locale keys: `vault_last_success_label` "Last success", `vault_last_success_never` "never", `vault_last_error_label` "Last error", `vault_last_error_none` "none".
- Settings -> General has a new **Secrets Vault** section with one number field, "Vault unreachable alert after (seconds)" (key `secrets.vault.unreachable_alert_after_seconds`, min 0, placeholder 120), with help text "Seconds the Vault backend may stay unreachable before datawatch raises an alert. Default 120; 0 disables the alert." Locale keys `settings_secrets_vault`, `settings_secrets_vault_unreachable_alert_after_seconds` and `..._help`, in en, de, es, fr and ja.
- Story `scripts/test-stories/pwa/vault-nav-label-clear.mjs` forces the Vault unreachable at 390 px and checks that nothing covers the Settings nav label and no Vault badge element exists.

## Gaps this work leaves

The app has not been changed or checked: it may still draw a Vault-unreachable marker on its Settings entry, lacks the last-success and last-error lines, and has no field for the alert delay. Whether the app's alert list shows the "Vault unreachable" and "Vault recovered" alerts has not been verified. There is no app-side check equivalent to the PWA story.

## Suggested next step

File one datawatch-app issue asking to: remove any Vault badge from the Settings entry; add the two lines to the Vault status row with the wording above; add the alert-delay field (read and write `secrets.vault.unreachable_alert_after_seconds` through the config API) using the PWA label and help text; confirm both alerts appear in the app alert list; add a narrow-screen label check. The operator should confirm where the field and lines sit in the app before filing. The default of 120 seconds was chosen by the Automaton, not the operator.
